scenarios.label: Conservative

sections.body: Amazon Shipping proposes to serve 1,054,120 annual parcels within supported Spain scope, subject to parcel-level eligibility checks.

sources_used.claim: Target margin 21%, minimum margin 13%, VP approval below 13%, automatic no-go below 9%.
Claims take nearly a month and require too much paperwork.
Lucia says Pink Papaya could launch Spain first and add France later if the plan is real.
Marta says France is not a maybe-later market and requires a credible timeline.
Last month Spain was about 76%, France 18%, Italy 5%, Portugal 1%.
Papaya Home has some heavy or awkwardly large items at low volume.
The vast majority of customers want home delivery because that is the Pink Papaya experience.
90% of parcels are apparel and accessories, most well under 2kg.
Pickup points are mostly a workaround because home delivery has been failing.
Normal volume is about 3,800 parcels per day; Black Friday reached roughly six times a normal day.
Sales spike Thursday to Sunday, making weekend operations relevant.
Supported challenge scope is Peninsular Spain and Balearics, 1-2 day delivery, OTP/SOD, max 15kg, max 80x80x60cm.
